issues.event: Ukraine opens battlefield AI drone data to allies
issues.article_text: Kiev abriu dados de 5 milhões de missões com drones a parceiros internacionais para treinar sistemas autônomos — o que o ministro Fedorov chamou de "primeira iniciativa do tipo no mundo".
issues.detail: The resolution was reported by AP/US News on March 12 and Defense News on March 13 — both before the edition window opened on March 14 at 10:00 BRT. Presented as news alongside fresh drone stories (Baykar K2, Merops deployment), not as background context.
